product_summary: Indo-MIM (Indo-US MIM Tec Pvt Ltd group, Bangalore, Karnataka) is a metal injection moulding (MIM) and investment-casting manufacturer. Publicly known product families: MIM and investment-cast precision metal components for automotive (sensor housings, fuel-system and transmission parts, small brackets), orthopaedic/medical implants and instruments, firearm components, defence/aerospace parts, consumer electronics and hardware, plus sintered/cast near-net-shape steel and stainless parts. NOTE: the company website (indo-mim.com) returned HTTP 307 redirects on every attempt and search engines returned no usable results within the tool budget, so the product list above could NOT be re-verified from the company's own catalogue in this session — it is stated from general public knowledge of the company and must be treated as 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until the site/catalogue is opened and cited.
comment: Declared codes: 732599 ('other cast articles of iron or steel') and 870870 ('road wheels and parts/accessories thereof'). 732599 is broadly consistent with the company's cast/sintered steel parts business — partial match, but the correct residual heading for MIM/sintered non-malleable steel articles is usually 732690 (other articles of iron or steel) or 732620 (articles of iron/steel wire) depending on the process; 732599 is a casting-specific residual code and may be too narrow for MIM (powder-metallurgy, not casting) output. 870870 (road wheels) is a very narrow automotive code: Indo-MIM does supply automotive components, but wheel/road-wheel parts are not a documented core line, so 870870 looks like a mis-mapped automotive code; the correct automotive residual would be 870899 (other parts and accessories of motor vehicles). Major product lines MISSING from the declaration: orthopaedic implants/instruments (9018), firearm parts (9305), general machinery parts (8487), tool/interchangeable parts (8207), and sintered metal parts. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a precision component manufacturer (metal injection moulding / powder metallurgy / investment casting), i.e. engineering/auto-components, not mining or primary metallurgy. No trader signs found (own plants, own brand, own engineering) — role manufacturer. Per Rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained and codes should be corrected to the actual product mix (732690 / 870899 / 9018 / 9305 as applicable). No customs line was available to me in this session, so no shipment-level corroboration of any code — all product-to-HS mapping is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN verification and registry checks were out of scope for this role and were not performed.
